text:
[IRET.7.2] Tokens grow left-to-right as the beta network
deepens. A token at a node with `n` patterns contains
`n` fact pointers. The last pattern's fact is always
`facts[n-1]`; earlier patterns are carried forward from
the left parent.

idris.name: iret_7_2__extend_tok
idris.note: The extended tokens: the token plus each joining fact, last.

idris.name: lnul_4_3__extends_iff_true
idris.note: A positive node extends a token by exactly the candidates answering true: every extension it passes is one, and every one is passed.

idris.name: lnls_5_1__extend_at_most_one
idris.note: The extension by the last pattern's fact: at most one under the anchor.

idris.name: iret_7_2__map_snoc_fwd
idris.note: Every token of the list, extended by the fact, is in the extension.

idris.name: iret_7_2__map_snoc_inv
idris.note: A token extended by a fixed fact comes from a token of the list.

idris.name: iret_7_2__snoc_inj
idris.note: Extension is injective: the same extended token has the same prefix and the same last fact.

idris.name: iret_7_2__snoc_not_nil
idris.note: An extended token is not the nil token.
